component.name: Pine
component.summary: Native GNOME workspace for code, Git, terminals, and CLI-agent tasks

description.p: Pine Desktop is a native GNOME application for working with CLI agents, code, Git, and several parallel tasks in a single observable workspace. An agent remains an ordinary CLI process in a real terminal; Pine does not replace it with a custom chat, but arranges alongside it an editor, project navigation, Git status, and a global Agent Inbox.
The user keeps control over the process and over changes: the agent works in the terminal, the code stays in view, and verification evidence stays observable.

First vertical slice of the native GNOME workspace: libadwaita window with adaptive sidebar, project tree, asynchronous editor with dirty-state saves, background Git status with bounded diff previews, VTE terminal, and Codex/Claude/Pi in the sample Agent Inbox.
